en.help.allowBody: Open Access controls → Definitions, select Node attributes. Append the snippet below to your existing nodeAttrs array; do not overwrite other access rules and do not add a second top-level nodeAttrs field.
en.help.allowHint: Save the policy and refresh this page. Public DNS and policy changes can take a few minutes to propagate.
en.help.allowTitle: If authorization does not complete: allow Funnel
en.help.faq1: "HTTPS must be enabled" — finish the HTTPS Certificates steps above.
en.help.faq2: "Funnel not available" — make sure the nodeAttrs snippet is saved and this node is in the rule's target.
en.help.faq3: Public URL exists but the phone times out: wait a few minutes, confirm the computer is awake and DSH is running, then re-scan the latest QR code.
en.help.faq4: No public URL: check that Tailscale authorization completed, then click "Refresh" or restart DSH.
en.help.funnelHint: The plugin bundles the Tailscale networking stack, so neither this computer nor the phone needs the Tailscale app — but a Tailnet administrator must approve first-time use.
en.help.httpsHint: Enabling HTTPS publishes the device hostname to public certificate transparency logs. Rename the device in Tailscale first if its name is sensitive.
en.help.httpsStep1: Open the Tailscale admin console → Network → DNS.
en.help.httpsStep3: In HTTPS Certificates click Enable HTTPS.
en.help.httpsTitle: If authorization does not complete: enable HTTPS
en.help.security1: A Funnel URL is public, but every connection requires a signature from a paired device P-256 private key. Do not share a pairing QR while it is valid.
en.help.security2: If a device is lost, delete only that device from the list. It disconnects immediately; other phones stay paired.
en.help.security3: Funnel and the LAN listener expose only /phone, /phone/pair, and /phone/health, never the full DSH Web/API surface.
en.help.security4: LAN uses the plugin's independent port 3098 with TLS enabled. Use trusted networks only and never forward that port to the public Internet.
en.help.security5: Disabling the remote switch stops Funnel but does not affect any LAN connection you already have.
en.help.step1: Turn on "DeepPilot connection" first, then "Remote connection (Tailscale Funnel)".
en.help.step2: When the status shows "Awaiting Tailscale authorization", click "Open authorization page".
en.help.step3: Sign in with an account that can manage this Tailnet and follow the on-page prompts to enable Funnel. Owner / Admin / Network admin is usually required.
en.help.step4: Come back to this page and click "Refresh". When a green dot appears next to the remote title, scan the QR code below to add your phone.
en.local.off: Off: LAN connections are not accepted.
en.local.on: On: phones connect over TLS through the independent port {port}.
en.local.portApplied: LAN port saved; the listener is reloading.
en.local.portDescription: Default 3098; range 1024–65535. This port serves only the three DeepPilot endpoints over TLS, never the full DSH server.
en.local.title: LAN connection
en.local.tlsRegenerated: The LAN TLS identity was regenerated: devices previously paired over LAN must scan a new pairing QR.
